Per-session project binding (N windows = N projects); an orchestrator that verifies each step's OUTPUT + a Stop-hook denetçi that forces skipped steps; per-session consent gates (push/delete/POST/sitemap/Indexing) + an AI-disclosure quarantine; an independent correctness oracle (the real ≤5% number); portfolio fan-out with an atomic cost/quota ledger + kill-switch; and an O5 fail-closed scheduler (default OFF). Path A, hardened by a 9-agent adversarial review; live-acceptance (D11) passed on a real GSC project. Production-ready: drift-check AMBER (F-16 + F-17 PASS), full pytest suite green (zero regression).
